headline: Unilever Shifts Advertising Spend from TV to Influencers, Impacting Channel 4
summary: Unilever has cut almost all TV advertising spend with British broadcaster Channel 4 in favor of digital influencer marketing campaigns.
why: Unilever is one of the world's largest consumer goods companies and a major global advertising spender.

impacts.name: Unilever
impacts.why: Reallocating ad budgets shifts marketing efficiency across media channels.
